items.source: An alternative to MvcUriComponentsBuilder.fromMappingName(String) for use with an instance of this class created via MvcUriComponentsBuilder.relativeTo(UriComponentsBuilder).
items.translation: `MvcUriComponentsBuilder.fromMappingName(String)` 的替代方案，用于通过 `MvcUriComponentsBuilder.relativeTo(UriComponentsBuilder)` 创建此类的实例。

items.source: An alternative to MvcUriComponentsBuilder.fromMappingName(String) that accepts a UriComponentsBuilder representing the base URL.
items.translation: 作为 `MvcUriComponentsBuilder.fromMappingName(String)` 的替代方案，它接受一个表示基础 URL 的UriComponentsBuilder。

items.source: MVC infrastructure for annotation-based handler method processing, building on the org.springframework.web.method.annotation package.
items.translation: 基于 org.springframework.web.method.annotation 包构建的用于注解式处理器方法处理的 MVC 基础设施。

items.source:
Use this method only if you need to apply strong encoding to expanded
URI variables by quoting all characters with reserved meaning.
items.translation: 仅在需要为展开的 URI 变量应用强编码（即引用所有具有保留含义的字符）时使用此方法。

items.source: Create a URL from the name of a Spring MVC controller method's request mapping.
items.translation: 从 Spring MVC 控制器方法的请求映射名称创建 URL。
